{"metadata":{"description":"Usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — lifetime token dashboard: 52-week activity heatmap (daily/weekly/cumulative), per-model trend + donut, streaks, plus a Codex-style /context lens","id":"gh:1336210596","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-scope","slug":"helloxkk/dsh-scope","topics":["context-window","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","heatmap","token-usage","usage-dashboard","usage-heatmap","usage-statistics"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — lifetime token dashboard: 52-week activity heatmap (da"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ily/weekly/cumulative), per-model trend + donut, streaks, plus a Codex-style /context lens"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-scope"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)** — a lifetime dashboard of your token usage across "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"every session, plus a context lens for the session you are in."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness computes rich token accounting and then shows you none of it. `dsh-scope` surfaces "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"computes rich token accounting and then shows you none of it. `dsh-scope` surfaces it in two places."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> One of several `dsh` plugins developed under
> `dsh-plugins/` — each an independent
> repo with it"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"s own release cadence."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Usage statistics (sidebar footer)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Open from the sidebar foot — a label when the sidebar is wide, an icon on the rail."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Lifetime summary** — cumulative and peak-day tokens, longest session, current and longest streak"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"s.
- **Token activity** — a 52-week heatmap in three modes: **daily** (each day colored on its own u"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"sage), **weekly** (each column summed) and **cumulative** (a running total across columns). One grid"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" reads either as a year at a glance or as growth over time.
- **Time range** — last 7 or 30 days, dr"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"iving both charts below.
- **Daily token trend** — one line per model, with a wrapping legend and pe"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"r-day tooltip. Only models used inside the window appear as series.
- **Model usage** — a donut with"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" the window total in the center and a percentage list beside it."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The whole panel is one request to the plugin's own loopback-only endpoint."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Context Lens (session header)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Window occupancy for the current session: a live occupancy ring in the header that opens into a segm"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ented system / tools / messages composition bar, per-bucket session totals, and KV-cache hit rate. I"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"t reads the official `token-meter` session projections through `useProjection` — no RPC, no custom w"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"fficial `token-meter` session projections through `useProjection` — no RPC, no custom wire protocol."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- `dsh` ≥ `0.1.0-rc.6` on your `PATH` (verified against `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.2.0-rc.2`)
- Node.js 22."},{"id":"p15s2","text":"18+ or 24.11+ (for building from source only)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`<profile>` is the directory under `~/.dsh/profiles/` that your dsh runs from — the Desktop app uses"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" is the directory under `~/.dsh/profiles/` that your dsh runs from — the Desktop app uses `desktop`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Install from source"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The script refuses an unknown profile rather than guessing."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The installer copies `lib/`, `cordis.patch.yml`, and `package.json` into the profile's `node_modules"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"` and appends the bundle insert to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It is idempotent — safe to re-r"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"un after every rebuild."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**Host half** (`lib/index.js`) — one read-only, loopback-fenced endpoint, `GET /api/dsh-scope/days`."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Aggregation is incremental. Per-session fold state is cached in memory and persisted to `~/.dsh/stor"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ages/dsh-scope-cache.json`, and each request folds only the events added since the last fold. Live s"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"essions fold their in-memory tail; persisted sessions skip work entirely while the backend's opaque "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"revision is unchanged, and otherwise read only the new suffix, with contiguity checks and a full ref"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"old when a log was truncated or rewritten. Steady-state cost stays O(new events) no matter how large"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"was truncated or rewritten. Steady-state cost stays O(new events) no matter how large the logs grow."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Fold semantics mirror `dsh-token-meter`'s `tokenUsage` projection. A usage sample rides an `assistan"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"t/chunk` (`data.chunk.type === "usage"`) or an `assistant/message` (`data.usage`). A repeated sample"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" for the same (turn, step) **replaces** the earlier value rather than double counting, re-attributed"},{"id":"p28s4","text":" to the later event's day and model. Model attribution follows `assistant/message`'s `data.message.s"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ource`, falling back to the last `request/header` config."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Beyond token buckets, the fold counts `turn/start` and `tool/call` events per day (feeding the weekl"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"y and cumulative heatmap tooltips) and tracks each session's first and last event timestamps so the "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"summary can report the longest session. The payload carries **every** model per day rather than a tr"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"uncated top-N, so the trend chart and donut always cover all of them."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**Client half** (`lib/client.js`, loaded via the package's `dsh.client` declaration):"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- `sidebar.footer.action` renders the usage trigger. The panel fetches `/api/dsh-scope/days` same-or"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"igin and derives every view from that single payload.
- `conversation.session.header.actions` (order"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" 30, after the job list) renders the lens trigger. Its popover reads three official projections — `t"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"okenUsage` (four buckets accumulated over the whole durable log), `contextPressure` (input-side wind"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"ow pressure plus the route's context window), and `contextBreakdown` (heuristic system/tools/message"},{"id":"p31s6","text":" composition of the next request)."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"`npm run build` emits two artifacts:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- `lib/index.js` — the Node host half. `@deepseek-ai/*` stays external and resolves against the prof"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ile's own installation at runtime.
- `lib/client.js` — the browser half, wrapped in the harness Modu"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"leLoader factory format. Platform modules (`react`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*`) stay external and r"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"esolve through the loader's injected `require`; everything else, including Recharts, is inlined."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Built and verified against `dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.2.0-rc.2` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` / `dsh-web-a"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"pp` bundles). The harness is in developer preview and iterates quickly — expect compatibility-breaki"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"). The harness is in developer preview and iterates quickly — expect compatibility-breaking changes."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"The host half reads persisted logs through whichever API the installed `sessionPersistence` exposes:"},{"id":"p40s2","text":" `open(id, 'read')` plus `handle.read(offset)` on `0.2.x`, and the older `readFrom(id, fromSeq)` els"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"ewhere. `list()` is normalized to `{ header, revision }` snapshots, so both shapes fold identically."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"dsh imports each plugin module once at startup, so a profile config reload cannot replace host-half "},{"id":"p41s2","text":"code: **restart dsh after rebuilding**."}],"truncated":true}
